mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 225.0 indicates persistent inflation, triggering central bank tightening that depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through rising real yields and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to deteriorating corporate revenue outlooks.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) triggers risk-off sentiment and reduced corporate investment, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through improved corporate earnings growth expectations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 600.0 (thousands of units) signals weak consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 600.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) combined with high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) creates stagflationary pressures, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through eroding profit margins and valuation compression.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.0% and UNRATE > 8.0%, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 4.0% signals restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through higher borrowing costs and reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
